network_enforcement: The release checker makes no network request. Its Lean corroboration invokes the existing validation runner, whose Lean subprocesses use Bubblewrap with an unshared network namespace and read-only host root.

expected_outputs.semantic_hash_policy: exact four-line blocked release summary from the hash-bound checker

scope_boundary: Reconciles current target authority, frozen obligation state, proof and validation receipts, and the recorded fresh narrow trust-zero Lean replay into an exact blocked release verdict. The Lean replay is run separately before this deterministic checker. This is same-worker nonrelease evidence, not an immutable cold empty-cache build, accepted dependency receipt, complete trust/source/readability record, independent runner, minimal independent verifier, deterministic release bundle, master acceptance, or theorem completion.
